result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall. Layout, spacing, images, badges, and the bottom navigation are aligned and legible. The only items I noticed are minor content and clarity points. The clipped category chips, clipped restaurant card, and partially visible card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar meta line repeats delivery information already shown in the '€0 delivery' badge on the card image.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery message in only one place, or keep the badge and drop the duplicate text from the meta line, to reduce clutter.

issues.description: The '−100%' badge on the pizza card has no context about what it discounts (item price, delivery fee, or the whole order).
issues.suggestion: Add a short qualifier such as 'Item −100%' or a tooltip so the promotion is clear at a glance.
